title: John McMurray and the single-headed snare drum
summary: Allen asks about McMurray's single-headed snare; Frazier knows of him but never saw such a drum and speculates how it worked.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you remember anything about this guy, John McMurray?
Yeah, he used to play on a single-headed snare drum, like a banjo hit.
Yeah, McMurray, let's see. I remember, yeah, John McMurray. Let's see. No, John... I heard lots about him. I remember John McMurray. I mean, I've seen him too much in person.
You tell me what this snare drum would be like. You ever seen a single-headed snare drum?
I'd never seen a single-headed snare drum, you know. It's actually being played by a single-headed snare drum.
You have no idea how there would be a single-head? Would it have the snare...
Well, I guess it would be similar to this... Like if I was to take this drum and just keep the batter aside and take the snare, it would be the same shell, you know.
Yeah, and put the snare underneath the batter, I guess.
That's all I could see. The only way you could... To get the vibration, to get the snare thick.
